text: Five cells near the middle: the R-pentomino. Every vsync is one generation.
The board lives in the banked window, not on the screen: cells[] at 0x4000, one byte per cell. Watch each generation rewrite it top to bottom, row by row.
Follow the head along one row: eight neighbour reads, one write, and the wrap at x=63 jumping back to x=0.
Try hz=2000000 for a few generations per second, or max to let the host run flat out. SPACE reseeds from rand(), so the seed lever decides the soup.
Scrub back to an earlier step: the snapshot ring restores both arrays and the display, and replay reaches the exact same generation.
